profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Game Engine, Harmony Pod
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer - Game Engine - Performance Engineering (Runtime Pod)
profile.summary:
Love learning about the intersection of hardware and code.  Understand hardware architecture and network protocols to write high performance code and tweak systems to maximize throughput, reduce latency.

Testing for statistically significant improvements.

Make expensive box go fast.

I enjoy learning from those around me and sharing my experiences with others.

Writing notes and reading books are two hobbies of mine.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Elastic Block Storage (Performance Team)
positions.description: C, C++, Go, Python, Perl, perf, ministat

positions.title: Software Engineer - Elastic Block Storage (Performance Team)
positions.description:
Create userspace object cache layer to reduce runtime jitter associated with memory allocations.  Caching layer takes advantage of multi-core architecture, processor cache lines, isolcpus, and asynchronous framework.  Latency and work queue load improvements increase available throughput of 300k+ fleet by 10%.

Interface with network driver to dynamically load previously unused network port on supported platforms, doubling available bandwidth while maintaining network redundancy requirements.  Enabled SRIOV virtual functions on existing receive queues; increased receive capacity of each queue by 75%.  Also plumbed automated metrics and monitoring to observe correctness on deployment and impact on fleet.

Extended core library to provide NUMA aware memory allocations on x86 platforms.

Test, observe, and tune network/system settings across fleet to minimize average and outlier latency.  

C, C++, Go, Rust, Python, Perl, perf, ministat

positions.title: Software Systems Engineer
positions.description:
-- SHELTER Contract (RIDDLES Follow-on) --
Formulates and defines specifications for complex operating software programming applications. 
 Modifies/maintains complex existing applications using engineering releases and utilities from the manufacturer.  Designs, codes, tests, debugs, and documents the aforementioned programs. 
 Responsible for applications dealing with the overall operating system, such as sophisticated file maintenance routines, large telecommunications networks, computer accounting, and advanced mathematical/scientific software packages.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Researched, designed, developed, and modified enterprise-wide system and application software that aided in software performance characterization and test automation. Planned system development and deployment while meeting software compliance standards. Evaluated interfaces between hardware, software, and operational requirements.

positions.title: Data Analyst | Operational Contract Support
positions.description: Led data gathering, analysis, and reporting of CENTCOM operational contract support integration for user requirements valued at $750M.   Provided data-driven action plans to consolidate similar requirements into fewer contracts to reduce overhead.

positions.title: Space Vehicles Directorate | Program Manager, Small Satellite Portfolio
positions.description: Managed 22-member multi-disciplinary team and $20M budget to deliver and conduct evaluations on the utility of small satellites for current and future Air Force missions.  Led 20 university space flight programs and advised 240 student engineers in small satellite design, build, launch and operations to develop future industry leaders.

positions.title: Space Vehicles Directorate | Chief, Director's Action Group
positions.description: Directed all external arrangements for the Director of the Space Vehicles Directorate, Air Force Research Laboratory.   Supported enterprise business processes for the $307M annual budget and 800 personnel to ensure delivery of mission critical space technologies.

positions.title: Space Vehicles Directorate | Deputy Branch Chief
Protected SATCOM Division | Software Transition and Launch Officer
positions.description: Led launch integration for $9.9B Advanced Extremely High Frequency (AEHF) constellation that verified flight readiness of satellite.  Directed a 45-member team on the air and ground shipment of the $1.7B AEHF satellite from Sunnyvale, CA to Cape Canaveral AFS, FL.

positions.title: Protected SATCOM Division | Business Management CASIES Lead
positions.description: Ensured smooth business operations to support survivable, secure, networked communications for President, Secretary of Defense, and Combatant Commanders for U.S. and coalition forces.  Guided $22M contract change proposal of long lead items to preserve mission critical launch timeline.

positions.title: Rider Coach
positions.description: Coached BasicRider training course: imparted key skills to new and experienced riders on motorcycle risk management and mitigation.
